input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
errors: First fill eval compared written lengths (model units, mm) to SI stored figures and showed 0 matches; fixed by converting with readUnits before scoring.
Cap check in footingLines first divided the SI volume by a body-unit length; caught by the eval (65 pad sections held back), fixed.

doc_friction.issue: Expects filled files named <x>__<stem>__<y>.ifc (stem = second '__' field) with a .written.json beside each; undocumented in its docstring, cost one failed run (KeyError).

deviations.why: Start-here said take the second open item no PR names; the row's buildable items each need a public export with specific stored figures, so I first inventoried stored Qto_ figures vs what the fill measures across 32 public files and took the largest unfilled class with complete stored data (Tekla footings).
deviations.did: Footing Qto_ from geometry, a new item rather than a listed one.
deviations.result: 482 of 505 offered figures match Tekla; 505 of 505 written values pass in IfcTester.

notes: Local checks: run_venture_tests ids-model-check (507 pass, 2 skipped) and ifc-quantity-takeoff (212 pass); check_posts ok; validate.py ok; venture-preflight run in background (see PR). Inventory of unfilled stored Qto_ figures recorded in the eval doc: openings (1,300+), railings Length (68), assemblies Width (1,051) are next.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: a BIM developer reverse-engineering Tekla's footing convention on 88 elements, coding, eval and IfcTester check

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
